name: LoResMT 2020 — shared task (test)
description: LoResMT 2020 Shared Task test sets — Hindi ↔ Bhojpuri, Hindi ↔ Magahi, and Hindi ↔ Russian (per-direction test files; bho→hi is 218 sentences, the rest 500). Fetched on demand from the shared-task repo at a pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Upstream does not document the test-set domain (labelled 'conv' with that caveat). Contamination HIGH — public since 2020 — so scores are relative-comparison-only. License CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 → non-commercial lanes only; cleared by the license review of 2026-08-24 into the NC research lane: benchmarkable; never in a commercial, prize, or API lane; remote evaluation only over no-train channels.

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Held-out shared-task benchmark: training on it defeats its purpose. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 → kept out of every commercial / prize / API lane. Content is fetched from source, never hosted.

contamination.reasoning: LoResMT 2020 test sets — public since 2020. Scores are valid only for relative method-vs-method comparison on this exact corpus, never as absolute quality. Forced HIGH here and via build_registry.HELD_OUT_BENCHMARK_FAMILIES.

licenseReview.basis: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, stated and verified at the pinned revision. Plain standard SPDX non-commercial license: benchmarkable; excluded from every commercial, prize, and API lane; remote evaluation only over channels that do not train on inputs (transmission_policy no-train lane).
